articles.title: ConvRot Quant method now in llama-cpp-turboquant
articles.metaDescription:
It started here , and now https://github.com/TheTom/llama-cpp-turboquant/ has it.
 Imagine a Q6 quant with nearly Q8 KLD/PPL.
 Q6_CR and Q5_CR have a slight improvement over their base counterparts.
articles.summary: Q6 quant with nearly Q8 KLD/PPL. Q6_CR and Q5_CR have a slight improvement over their base counterparts.
